name: story-composer-01
title: Story Composer 01
author: ilinxa
description: Instagram-canonical story creation surface — camera-first capture, multi-layer Konva editor, 6 edit tools, single-pointer drag-to-pan + pinch/wheel zoom, an Instagram-style top bar (capture mode tabs swap to a back arrow in the edit stage), video record + trim + overlay bake, publish via XHR + uploader escape hatch, undo/redo, permission-denied auto-retry, discard-confirm guard. The capture + canvas + edit-tool surface is delegated to @ilinxa/media-editor-01; story-composer-01 ships only the story-shaped wrapper (publish bar, publish progress, story state) on top.
